observation.quality_flags_basis: AirNow's hourly files carry no per-value quality flag: only valid data are reported, a missing value is a line or a field that is not there, and every value is preliminary (the Hourly Data and Hourly AQ Obs fact sheets; research-station-text F08, F09). HourlyAQObs's *_Measured fields say whether a site measures a pollutant and stay in the residual.

source_time_system.basis: the AirNow fact sheets: the valid date and valid time are GMT and mark the beginning of a one-hour measurement period (research-station-text F08)
source_time_system.name: GMT

residual.namespace: EPA AirNow hourly observation files (HourlyData, HourlyAQObs)

source.format_name: EPA AirNow hourly observation files (HourlyData, HourlyAQObs)
source.format_version: AirNow Hourly Data File fact sheet (last updated August 2025) and Hourly AQ Obs File fact sheet (updated March 2023)
transformations: the valid date and time are read as the GMT start of a one-hour period; observed_at is its end, one hour later
a two-digit year is read as 20YY: AirNow's hourly files begin in 2019
each value's decimal text is read as a binary floating-point number
